newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe down again on bankruptcy fears.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe down again on bankruptcy fears.

text.p: Shares in Polish construction firm Espebepe SA tumbled 9.7 percent to 5.1 zlotys but did not trade after price-fixing for the third consecutive day due to excess supply on growing concern that the company may go bankrupt.
Espebepe has fallen 26 percent in the last three sessions since a court on Friday postponed until April 14 a creditors' meeting to decide on a possible debt write-off deal.

"Everyone expects the worst now...some speculated on the stock before the meeting, hoping the deal would be clinched, so the delay was a disappointment and those who have the shares started to panic," one trader said.
The Espebepe creditors' meeting on Friday was deemed invalid by the court for procedural reasons.
